SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.learned_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS new_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.learned_at IS NOT NULL AND ((s.scheduler_type = 'eight_box' AND s.current_box < #{thresholds.reviewingBox}) OR (s.scheduler_type = 'sm2' AND s.interval_days < #{thresholds.reviewingDays})) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS learning_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.learned_at IS NOT NULL AND ((s.scheduler_type = 'eight_box' AND s.current_box >= #{thresholds.reviewingBox} AND s.current_box < #{thresholds.masteredBox}) OR (s.scheduler_type = 'sm2' AND s.interval_days >= #{thresholds.reviewingDays} AND s.interval_days < #{thresholds.masteredDays})) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reviewing_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.learned_at IS NOT NULL AND ((s.scheduler_type = 'eight_box' AND s.current_box >= #{thresholds.masteredBox}) OR (s.scheduler_type = 'sm2' AND s.interval_days >= #{thresholds.masteredDays})) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mastered_count FROM cards c INNER JOIN card_study_states s ON s.card_id = c.id WHERE c.deck_id = #{deckId} AND c.delete_batch_id IS NULL
